entries.title: Psalms 2:1
segments: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?

entries.title: Psalms 2:2
segments: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 2:3
segments: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.

entries.title: Psalms 2:4
segments: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 2:5
segments: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:

entries.title: Psalms 2:6
segments: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 2:7
segments: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.

entries.title: Psalms 2:8
segments: Ask of me, and I will give [thee] the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

entries.title: Psalms 2:9
segments: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

entries.title: Psalms 2:10
segments: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 2:11
segments: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 2:12
segments: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.
